project_title: Project #14762: Power Bi - GBS Q&T Management Process Improvement

define.problem_statement: During 2025 at GBS Silao, the Quality and Transformation area required the management of information for each automated project using a lot of time, 60 hours per year. An area of opportunity was observed in the process for the consolidation of the information of the projects developed and the generation of statistical reports. Also, the team was investing in this process $100K USD annually due to projects loss of information.
objective_bullets: Establish a standard and optimized process for managing team projects and enable project benefits.
Create an automated tool (Power Bi) that consolidates information and generate reports on automated projects.
Time reductions of 80% (48 hours), associated with project upload and reporting.
Enable Cost Avoidance of 100% ($100k USD annually)
benefit_bullets: Time optimization of 80% in this activity (48 annual hours).
Just 1 Power BI file per report
Just one revision with the team
define.glossary_text:
JE: Journal Entry, an accountable document posted in ledger.
Cost center: Numerical distinction for a certain engineering group.
Entity: GMM site.
WD: Working day
Q&T: Quality and Transformation
GBS: Global Business Solutions
CICP: Continuous Improvement Culture Program

before_list: Waste of time in manual processing
Not so formal way of presenting
after_list: Reduction of 80% of the duration of the activity.
Just 1 Power BI file per report
The Power BI will be automatic
Just one revision with the team
intangible_benefits.confirmation_note: Benefits confirmed with two pilots completed in May and June 2025. 80% of time improvement achieved. Benefits will keep being monitored during Sustain phase and final benefit will be updated

summary_lines: First year cost avoidance (from May to December 2025 = ($8,333 USD x 8 months ) = ~$67k USD
tangible_benefits.projected_note: Projected cost avoidance is $100K USD year over year ($8,333 USD monthly). Projected 3 years savings is $0.267M USD ($267K USD) starting May 2025 to December 2027

implementation_plan.action: Standards and Procedures Developed and In Place

solutions_evidence.before_text: An Excel form had to be filled out with each project criteria.
solutions_evidence.after_text: A system was created in SharePoint with standard criteria, more friendly and easy to use, eliminating manual errors.
solutions_evidence.pilot_note_1: Sharepoint Improvements were validated during May and June 2025. A total of two pilots implemented
solutions_evidence.pilot_note_2: Power Bi Improvements were validated during May and June 2025. A total of two pilots implemented

control_plan.x: X1: Document and consolidate the information in Sharepoint.
control_plan.method: Capture the time that take the process to fill data in SharePoint.
control_plan.action: Measure the time that takes to capture, create and visualized the information of project.
control_plan.reaction_plan: Communicate and provide feedback if X1 > 48 minutes; planned action items: verify automatic information displays correctly, check notification is sent, confirm root causes and implement action plans.

control_plan.x: X2: Update reports in Power Bi
control_plan.method: Capture the time that take the process to visualized dashboard at Power BI automation tool.
control_plan.action: Measure the time it takes to create the report to verify that it is within the determined range.
control_plan.reaction_plan: Communicate and provide feedback if X2 > 12 minutes; planned action items: verify SharePoint/Power BI connection, review Teams hosting and scheduled refresh, confirm root causes.

control_plan.method: Capture the cost per lost project per month
control_plan.action: Measure the cost it takes per lost project
control_plan.reaction_plan: Communicate and provide feedback if X3 > $0 USD; confirm action plans implemented, process adopted, finance data accurate.

control_plan.target: Make sure Future State Map is followed as defined
control_plan.method: Follow Future State Map and evaluate it during pilots
control_plan.action: Implement Future State Map activities into improved process and validate it during pilot runs
control_plan.reaction_plan: Communicate and agree any changes needed in Future process map to the team and explain why updates are needed.
